scope: One capture boundary for all eight actual metadata categories with explicit committed identities, unconditional builtin Range, and compiled CSharp Range schema. Production registry population/cache consumption remain pending.
decisions: CSharp always registers Range with ordered start/endInclusive Int fields independently of source uses. Compile that complete schema once and consume it in the real CSharp factory and SLG metadata/resolved names.
Entire CSharp registered metadata and hash stay identical before/after the production factory extraction.

Capture receives explicit committed identities rather than treating the semantic scratch arena as the registry. Check all identities and duplicates before capture; return only a complete owning result.
Always include builtin Range once, including an empty source registration list. Preserve the native ABI identities of declared/affine/synthetic types, storage and references.
Use actual finalized enum payload geometry and the existing eight record suppliers; no independent layout engine or guessed words.
Reuse a single-reference supplier for both per-identity capture and the retained all-reference adapter.

Normalize actual CSharp records for all eight fixture categories; preserve primitive box alias multiplicity. Builtin dynamic Int arrays are implicit in CSharp rather than entries in DynamicArrays; the fixture deliberately exercises a real registered dynamic Pair array.
Negative controls cover duplicate identities, a non-metadata scalar identity, and an unrelated valid scratch reference not selected by the registry.
